hero.title: Undergraduate Computer Engineering in Denmark for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Experience collaborative Scandinavian engineering education in Denmark with an English-taught Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Systems, mastering embedded IoT hardware and green electronics under SIRI stay-back regulations.

overview: Denmark is internationally recognized for sustainable design, green technological innovation, and world-leading industrial automation. Studying undergraduate Computer Engineering in Denmark provides Indian students with an active, problem-based learning pedagogy focused on developing energy-efficient computing hardware, embedded sensor networks, and robotic control systems.

Danish research universities and technological institutes offer English-taught 3-year Bachelor of Science and 3.5-year Bachelor of Engineering (BEng, Professional Bachelor) programs. Students work in small project teams solving real-world engineering challenges in digital circuit design, microcontroller programming, embedded Linux, and hardware-software co-design, collaborating directly with Danish industrial leaders.

Under regulations administered by the Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI), international graduates from state-approved Danish higher education institutions can apply for a post-study job-seeking residence permit. For third-country students whose initial residence permit application for a state-approved professional bachelor's, bachelor's, part-time master's, or master's programme is submitted on or after 1 October 2026, the job-seeking period granted is 1 year (12 months); earlier applications generally retain up to 3 years, and PhD graduates receive up to 3 years. Graduates may seek qualified employment to transition into standard work schemes such as the Pay Limit Scheme or Fast Track.
